declaration_verdict.note: SINGLE_SOURCE_OK; relation different formulation; the auditor's reading: ContDiff R infinity H and ContDiff R infinity K imply ContDiff R infinity (velocity H K). This IS the (4.4)-to-(4.5) implication: smooth profiles in (t,s,z) give a smooth Cartesian velocity, the axis included, with no removable-singularity step. It asks for smoothness on ALL of the (s,z) plane.
